notes: The method loads natively from the arm's own config: six slash commands and skills under .claude/ (manifest.json:2-13), and the checklist finds none missing. But it runs its steps through a separate `method` CLI that the model calls from the shell (06/transcript.md:16-17). The GitHub Issues tracker is not part of the workflow: the model reads issue #2 with its own `gh issue view` call (06/transcript.md:2) and only mentions it in commit text as 'Part of troupe-run/repo#2' (06/transcript.md:64). No transcript shows an issue being created or closed, so the tracker works one way at most and stays a separate chore.
